reply.summary: Tasormi is a blond precinct detective who cheerfully looks away while a masked killer cleans up the streets. Tasormi cares only about an easy shift and a quiet desk.

feats.scene: Tasormi cuffs a stunned suspect with a hard shove against a wall.
Tasormi bounces off a parked car and shrugs it off.

reply.summary: Resrirum is a greying crooked cop who also peddles drugs, sneering at anyone weaker than himself. Resrirum relies on a pistol and a bully's swagger.

feats.scene: Resrirum fires his pistol and shatters a streetlamp.
Resrirum takes a kick to the gut and spits blood but stays upright.

reply.summary: Rnamoiu is a venal beat detective who leans on witnesses, takes envelopes, and beats up kids for fun. Rnamoiu is the unwelcome first partner of a new honest arrival.

feats.scene: Rnamoiu swings a baton into a suspect's ribs in a back alley.
Rnamoiu takes a hard punch from a street thug and laughs.

reply.summary: Llulaus is a curator who believes himself the true guardian of a tropical island, his body made of living metal. Llulaus flies, hits like a train, and meets every outsider with a spear.

feats.scene: Llulaus shapes a metal fist and punches through a concrete seawall.
Llulaus reforms his body after a truck-mounted cannon blast.

reply.summary: Rnrni is a late-night comedian and talk host who fears silence from his audience above all else. Rnrni once awoke latent mind powers that briefly turned him into a hulking dune beast.

feats.scene: Rnrni swells into a sand giant and crushes a parked bus with one swipe.
Rnrni scatters into grit when struck, then pours back together.

reply.summary: Nuneo is a heavyset mercenary in a hand-me-down powered suit whose boosters let him pull down apartment blocks. Nuneo stomps the ground to cause tremors and has been hired by many a master villain.

feats.scene: Nuneo stomps and a block of flats shudders into rubble.
Nuneo shrugs off a cannon round that dents his plating.

reply.summary: Raneon is a crook-turned-engineer who built his own armour to stamp out earthquakes across a lakeside city. Raneon was beaten when his suit was taken apart piece by piece.

feats.scene: Raneon pounds a street and sends a quake rolling under a dozen blocks.
Raneon keeps charging after being flung through a billboard.

reply.summary: Ronrn is a lonely drunk in a quiet town, shunned for a betrayal he did not commit. Ronrn can teleport and used the gift to send a huge falling bomb away to empty desert.

feats.scene: Ronrn blinks a falling bomb out of the sky and drops it into a vacant dune field.
Ronrn drops from a rooftop onto a hay pile and walks off dazed.

reply.summary: Ernia is a polished mob boss who once ran a city's rackets and shielded a nephew from the law. Ernia gave himself up to save his son after rivals closed in.

feats.scene: Ernia slams a ledger on a table and a cup tips over.
Ernia keeps a straight face after a bodyguard's clumsy shove sends him into a bookcase.

reply.summary: Ilsala is a meek puppeteer who lets a gruff wooden alter ego run his gang. Ilsala is fractured in mind, but his schemes catch a masked vigilante off guard.

feats.scene: Ilsala swings his puppet like a club at a rival's jaw.
Ilsala keeps muttering after being thrown into a stack of crates.

reply.summary: Corruslle is a faceless gun-for-hire who brings an arsenal of heavy weapons to every job. Corruslle fights an old team of oddball heroes for pay.

feats.scene: Corruslle opens fire with a heavy rifle and perforates a steel door.
Corruslle takes a punch from a bruiser and tumbles up smiling.

reply.summary: Iarsornau is a hired killer inside a bulky armoured shell with a gun for one hand and a blade for the other. Iarsornau was beaten by a team of misfit heroes and his shell was later stolen.

feats.scene: Iarsornau chops through a steel girder with his blade hand.
Iarsornau stays standing after a van slams into his plating.

reply.summary: Tanrnoror is a proud warrior woman who once held a grand title and fought for her people's honour. Tanrnoror turned bitter at defeat, conquered a coastline with a lover, and finally died challenging a goddess.

feats.scene: Tanrnoror leads a charge that levels a hill fortress with sheer strength.
Tanrnoror takes a collapsing wall and rises to keep fighting.

reply.summary: Sorsi is a high-ranking general of an island army who leads her sisters to battle against meddling gods. Sorsi died by throwing herself in front of a deadly bolt meant for her queen.

feats.scene: Sorsi drives a spear through a bronze shield and its bearer staggers back.
Sorsi takes a divine lightning strike to shield another, and it ends her.

reply.summary: Seneo is one of five primordial mothers who shaped a warrior people and breathed life into a clay child. Seneo lends power to others and cannot wholly step into the physical world.

feats.scene: Seneo pours her hunting might into a clay figure and a whole island shakes.
Seneo stays unchanged as a stormfront crashes through her spirit form.

reply.summary: Anntilan is a lethal assassin of an ancient sisterhood, bound by blood oath to two sisters and nearly deathless. Anntilan once hid inside a wooden horse to end a famed war.

feats.scene: Anntilan whirls a long blade and cuts down three guards at once.
Anntilan walks out of a burning keep with a clean cloak.

reply.summary: Leoanria is a striped-costume villain with matchless aim, acrobatic flips and a love of crossbows. Leoanria lurks among the scoundrel groups of a small island nation.

feats.scene: Leoanria fires an arrow through a hanging lamp from the far end of a hall.
Leoanria tumbles off a balcony and lands in a roll.

reply.summary: Nassartes is a red-haired war master who beat a rival princess in a contest of champions and later led her people's defence. Nassartes is blunt, dangerous and loyal to her own honour code.

feats.scene: Nassartes drives a sword through a stone altar in one swing.
Nassartes takes a boulder to the shoulder and keeps her guard up.

reply.summary: Rersenal is a red-haired sellsword who left her tribe behind and now works alongside a crew of outlaws. Rersenal swings a gifted blade and hits hard in a scrap.

feats.scene: Rersenal cleaves a steel drum in half with a single stroke.
Rersenal takes a rifle butt to the jaw and grins.

reply.summary: Ronteltia is a king of a sunken realm, raised on dry land by humble farmers. Ronteltia was born in the shadow of civil war and barely survived being buried in rubble.

feats.scene: Ronteltia heaves a ship aside and clears a harbour channel.
Ronteltia lies pinned beneath a collapsed quay for hours and lives.

reply.summary: Netoran is a minor puzzle-obsessed crook who copies a more famous rival and sends cryptic notes to the law. Netoran was easily jailed and later joined a villains' gathering.

feats.scene: Netoran swings a rolled-up map and bops a guard on the head.
Netoran shrugs off a tumble down a staircase in a hurry.

reply.summary: Raareon is a cruel crook in an altered timeline who forced his own wife to take her last pills. Raareon met his end at his daughter's hands in a frantic scuffle.

feats.scene: Raareon shoves a table over to block a doorway.
Raareon grapples hard against a wall and shakes off the impact.

reply.summary: Iusan is a sea-hero from a lost parallel world, strong, quick and hard to hurt. Iusan reaches out to marine creatures with his thoughts, but a demon's horde overran him and his friends.

feats.scene: Iusan hurls a wrecked ship hull across a bay and flattens a dock.
Iusan stands against waves of infernal troops before the tide finally turns.

reply.summary: Anriia is a young sea monarch who wields an enchanted trident and an easy way with animals. Anriia fights with flair and swims faster than most people run.

feats.scene: Anriia whirls a trident and cracks a breakwater.
Anriia is slammed into a reef and rises with a smile.

reply.summary: Ialile is a stern older ruler of the seas who gave up his hero mantle to a pupil and now guards seventy percent of a planet. Ialile refuses to let the surface dump its problems in his waters.

feats.scene: Ialile snaps a fishing trawler's mast with a backhand.
Ialile endures a crushing trench-bottom pressure and strolls away.

reply.summary: Nausasst is a loud, tough prince of the seas who calls water flows with sorcery and hears through echoes. Nausasst clashes with a cheerful band of misfits and hurls his trident with lethal skill.

feats.scene: Nausasst slams a trident down and raises a wall of water over a pier.
Nausasst takes a cargo container to the chest and snickers.

reply.summary: Telcer is a blond king of the deep who refuses to hand his people to a tyrant overseas. Telcer fights twin speedsters, a lightning-wielder, and even his own double, and refuses to surrender.

feats.scene: Telcer summons a monstrous whirlpool that tears a fleet apart.
Telcer withstands a double blow of lightning and a speeding punch.

reply.summary: Amorenle is a blond crimefighter among a new wave of heroes in the shadow of an older fading team. Amorenle relies on courage and a seaman's wits.

feats.scene: Amorenle swings a boat hook and smashes a smuggler's crate.
Amorenle takes a rope-burn fall off the pier and surfaces laughing.

reply.summary: Vortan is a half-surface monarch of the oceans and a founder of a world-guarding team. Vortan is strong, swift and sturdy, with a bond to animals and a mighty trident.

feats.scene: Vortan hurls a trident that cleaves a rock island clean in two.
Vortan shoulders a falling oil rig and brushes off the debris.

reply.summary: Eorse is a white-haired, half-machine sea-king who has lost his love and his oceans. Eorse stitched himself together from salvaged cyborg parts and wields teleporting portals.

feats.scene: Eorse rips open a portal and throws a whole warship through it.
Eorse takes a blast of heat and keeps stalking forward.

reply.summary: Niueruori is a sea-king and hero who gathered with friends to decide how to handle a furious crowd. Niueruori died when ordinary people turned on every hero they once cheered.

feats.scene: Niueruori lifts a collapsed beam that pins a dozen people.
Niueruori is overwhelmed by thousands of angry hands and finally falls.

reply.summary: Raton is a golden-haired singer in a band of four friends signed to a stingy label. Raton watched the band split over a musical disagreement.

feats.scene: Raton hurls a guitar pick that pings off a cymbal.
Raton tumbles off the stage into the crowd and gets passed back up.

reply.summary: Urnstuvi is a dark-haired teen raised in a lighthouse who rescues a drowning stranger and learns he is heir to a sea throne. Urnstuvi hears marine creatures and faces a hard truth about his life.

feats.scene: Urnstuvi hauls a boat onto the shore by hand.
Urnstuvi takes a rough tackle on the sand and brushes it off.

reply.summary: Colsoneo is a white-haired survivor in a poisoned future ocean, once a king and now a lonely wanderer. Colsoneo grieves the silence of the seas and hopes a hardy shark signals recovery.

feats.scene: Colsoneo throws a trident that pins a mutant leviathan to a cave wall.
Colsoneo wades through radioactive muck with only a scar to show for it.

reply.summary: Esauaun is a tiny royal infant known fondly as a baby of the waves, a quarter surface-born and three quarters of the deep. Esauaun was lost young when the throne was seized from his parents.

feats.scene: Esauaun swats a toy boat across a nursery pool.
Esauaun bumps a tub rim and giggles.

reply.summary: Olutel is a nineteenth-century sailor-explorer who survived a polar betrayal and learned a mysterious force from a hidden city. Olutel spent years among strange people before returning to share a half-told tale.

feats.scene: Olutel channels a pulse of hidden force that splinters a pier.
Olutel crawls out of a collapsing ice crevice with bruises.

reply.summary: Naori is a lab-raised boy given gills to survive and educated by television inside a big tank. Naori later takes up a famous mantle after a series of dreams from another being.

feats.scene: Naori splashes out of a tank and flings a bucket across the lab.
Naori is thrown by a storm surge and clings to a rock.

reply.summary: Niltaam is a convicted, murderous villain who throws bursts of brilliant light and flies. Niltaam escapes jail and goes on a rampage, with the city's defenders away.

feats.scene: Niltaam fires a dazzling blast that levels the front of a department store.
Niltaam takes a police barrage and keeps hovering.

reply.summary: Renrnelu is a bald, tired man in a future that bans active powers, who flings weak beams of light. Renrnelu fell behind on his dampening pills and was hauled in by a task force.

feats.scene: Renrnelu flashes a beam that burns through a metal door.
Renrnelu is tackled by two agents and shakes it off before cuffs close.

reply.summary: Nastete is a widowed sea-king in a blended world, a wartime veteran who later joined a new team. Nastete is strong and fast, with deep swimming skill and blade training.

feats.scene: Nastete punches a submarine hull and cracks its plating.
Nastete survives a depth charge and surfaces annoyed.

reply.summary: Rannia is a legendary sovereign who awakens from enchanted slumber to defend his island in a far-off future. Rannia rallies knights, loves a queen, and fears a scheming half-sibling.

feats.scene: Rannia swings a broadsword through a thick oaken gate.
Rannia takes a lance blow on his shield and keeps his saddle.

reply.summary: Tiacolanu is a just monarch of a castle kingdom who trusts a wise sorcerer to jail a fallen knight. Tiacolanu is a skilled swordsman and political leader.

feats.scene: Tiacolanu swings a sword and cleaves a shield in two.
Tiacolanu stands up to a heavy mace blow and rallies his guard.

reply.summary: Auallrni is an exiled young prince who swims well and carries the blood of two peoples. Auallrni was blamed for a kidnapping that was no fault of his and sent from the palace.

feats.scene: Auallrni grips a railing hard enough to bend it slightly.
Auallrni scrapes a coral wall and swims on.

reply.summary: Seamlor is a small, loud seabird who leads a gang of feathered thieves and talks in a thick cockney drawl. Seamlor freezes the feet of his foes and pecks away at their patience.

feats.scene: Seamlor flaps at a guard dog and sends a pile of gems skittering.
Seamlor tumbles from a high shelf and shakes his feathers.

reply.summary: Sonler is a metal butler built to serve, now a free-minded ally in a rebel band. Sonler is strong, swift and tough, and can mimic voices and read the make-up of anything.

feats.scene: Sonler crushes a steel hatch like foil and tosses it aside.
Sonler is finally scrapped after a barrage from enemy warships.

reply.summary: Stlisau is a blue-skinned marksman and instructor of a galactic patrol, fond of teaching rookies to aim. Stlisau flies and shoots glowing beams, but a huge beast devoured him mid-battle.

feats.scene: Stlisau fires a pinpoint beam that bores through an asteroid.
Stlisau holds a shield as a giant creature snaps its jaws around him.

reply.summary: Iatelrn is a grey-skinned, multi-armed warden with cyborg claws and a cruel streak. Iatelrn treats prisoners as trophies and relishes breaking them.

feats.scene: Iatelrn rakes his metal claws through a steel cell door.
Iatelrn laughs as a volley of slugs ricochets off his plates.

reply.summary: Llient is a television news reporter who once cheered on a masked crusader, then turned against vigilantes after riots. Llient broadcast live from a tower and carried an injured woman to safety.

feats.scene: Llient swings a microphone and knocks a camera cable out of the way.
Llient scrambles out of a collapsing clock tower with scrapes.

reply.summary: Tumnan is a yellow-eyed young hero from a far-off world who turns into a random monstrous shape in emergencies. Tumnan shrugs off prejudice, unable to choose his form, and may sprout wings, claws or size.

feats.scene: Tumnan swells into a winged beast and tears a hull plate from a freighter.
Tumnan takes a blast to the chest in beast form and roars back.

reply.summary: Siorite is a shapeshifting exile who runs a global company as cover for a secretive faction. Siorite was exposed after a weapon from his firm killed a lawmaker.

feats.scene: Siorite stretches an arm into a hammer and smashes a security door.
Siorite reshapes around a burst of gunfire and slips away.
